issue.title: test_disabled_path_resurfaces_silenced_once_and_ignores_others fails: hardcoded 20261009 stamp is outside the 7-day healer lookback
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `tests/test_agent_auto_restart_sweep_safety.py::test_disabled_path_resurfaces_silenced_once_and_ignores_others`; `src/sase/agent/auto_restart/healer_targets.py` (`_HISTORY_LOOKBACK_SECONDS`, `resolve_pending_targets`)

Isolated reproduction (also NEW in ToolRun 42b81a5ad80031752e1be256c1e85cf7 during sase-1le landing):

```
.venv/bin/pytest tests/test_agent_auto_restart_sweep_safety.py::test_disabled_path_resurfaces_silenced_once_and_ignores_others -q
```

Asserts `counts == [1, 0, 0]` and gets `[0, 0, 0]`. `run_job_tick` still reports `action="disabled"`. Dumping `_collect_job_work` on the same fixture shows `full_scan True` and `targets []`.

Root cause: the fixture writes the silenced row under stamp `20261009T120000`. Healer enumeration only walks failed rows newer than `_HISTORY_LOOKBACK_SECONDS` (7 days) via `not_before_timestamp`. On 2026-10-16 that stamp is outside the window, so `resolve_pending_targets` never returns the pending-recovery row and `_resurface_for_disabled` has nothing to resurface.

Not a parallel-lane flake: it fails in isolation in 2.2s. Not caused by the sase-1le docs landing diff (that tale does not touch auto-restart).

Fix direction: give the fixture a stamp inside the lookback (relative to `now`), or freeze time in the test. Confirm other hardcoded `20261009T*` rows in the same file before they age out the same way.

The disabled-path contract (silenced pending rows resurface exactly once while auto-restart is off) is untested until this is fixed.

task_type_fields.impact: Scoped just check fails NEW on this node once the fixture stamp ages past 7 days; auto-restart disabled-path resurface coverage is dark.

issue.creation_reason: Found during sase-1le landing verification. ToolRun 42b81a5ad80031752e1be256c1e85cf7 classified the node NEW; isolated pytest reproduces it, and the silenced fixture stamp 20261009T120000 is now older than _HISTORY_LOOKBACK_SECONDS so resolve_pending_targets returns no targets.
